2026

Storm Still Raging
The Whole Story
Still Human Beings
Heaven's Feigned Bliss
Another Me
Not Out of the Woods
Life of a Certain Kind
Even In Our Own Hearts
Out of Myself
Not the Sky
Hiccupping Whiskey
Unveiling
Savage Humanity
Who is the One
Wrong Turn
Beyond Good and Evil
Dreaming
For What Purpose
Uncertain Certainties
From Place to Place
The only thing left
Take These To Heart
When God Dies
Youthful Infatuation
Phony
Innocence
The Darkest Possibilities
Dance of Hope and Doubt
Not Rational
Resist Nature
The Pain of Reality
Babylon
Mysteries
Into The Abyss
How Much
Friend To Nothing
Uncharted Waters

2025

Life Is Strange
As If Love Can't Be Questioned
Rising Halfway
So Was I
Dark Abyss
Wisely in Spite of Ignorance
Hope
The Hard Rock of Reality
The Present
Angry, Solid Blue
They prefer the abuse
How Much Time
Nothing
Somewhere, Somehow
The Curtain Falls
The Form of the Matter
Never Been Wrong
From Beyond
C'est la vie

2024

Out there in history
Less Imposing Principles
No Leg Up
Many, Instead of One
We didn't move
The Discipline of Virtue
Nothing but Chaos
Everyone's Wrong
On the Verge
A Warning
Good Left Undone
Somewhere Other Than Belief
A Start
The Wind and My Place in It
Surely We Know Best
Sending Signs
All as One
Anti-Nature
Wait For Me
Whatever Comes
More Authentic
Response to a Query
It may also help you
Doubt

2023

Barrel of Monkeys
Who Does the Promising?
Pliable by Nature
Still More
Discard Them Already
Someone Tell Wittgenstein
We Silly Mammals
That which wants to be said
Trust or Freedom
Sources II
Moldy Thinking
Bind
In the depths of it
Spiraling
Clarity is like Death
Blank Space
No Single Force
Both How and Why
Pain That One Calls Home
Uncivilized After All These Years
Banishing Night
Menagerie of Rules
Monotheism
The Scientist
Contrition
Some Other
Wallow
Good Eyes
culmination
On Whose Authority
What time is this
Not even sure who to ask
Small All the Same
Emptiness That None Can Understand
Think Not Absolutely
Wait For Another
Slumber Much Better

The New Frontier
Industrial Man
Theodicy
Reasonable Measure
Beatific Visions
Belly of the Whale
Myth at Twilight
Light
Let Go
Who is in charge here
